column2: 3rd analysis - run from scratch on 2026-10-12, starting from a new PSI-BLAST search. No artefact of any earlier run was reused.
Hyaluronidase PH-20 / SPAM1, Homo sapiens, UniProt P38567, 509 aa (query fetched fresh from UniProt)
signal peptide 1-35 | secreted rHuPH20 36-482 | GPI tail 483-509
Glu148 (proton donor, UniProt annotation)
epiSCANEER (McBASC co-evolution network + epistatic SCI), github.com/khsub87/epiSCANEER; protocol of Nucleic Acids Research 2026, 54, gkag879

PSI-BLAST 2.14.0+ against UniRef90, single iteration, e-value threshold 0.001, BLOSUM62, gap 11/1, filter off. EBI job psiblast-R20261012-064732-0715-96467920-p1m, submitted 2026-10-12. Database snapshot 2026-08-27, 121,494,192 sequences. 4679 hits, all from round 1, worst e-value 0.00091; the service's 5000-hit cap was not reached.
minus the query's own UniRef90 cluster; minus 1009 hits outside 0.7-1.3x the query length (356.3-661.7); minus 0 hits with >=90% identity to the query -> 3669 homologs

The paper imposes no cap on homolog count. The 3669 homologs were truncated to the 500 most significant PSI-BLAST hits (e-value ranking, the search's own ordering), under the instruction given for this environment. Kept identity 42.0-89.6%, median 54.1%. Reason: MUSCLE with default parameters needs about 7.1 h per refinement iteration at 3670 sequences (measured), with up to 14 iterations at the default -maxiters 16, and this container is reclaimed when the session goes idle.
MUSCLE with ClustalW output and default parameters, as the paper specifies. 501 sequences (query + 500), 1301 columns, 1.8 min. Input: input/PH20_run3.aln
PDB 9JUB chain A (PH20 residues 37-442, deposited in P38567 numbering), downloaded fresh for this run
978 residue pairs, from 1018 predicted pairs after removing pairs that touch a disulfide cysteine, an N-glycosylation site or the catalytic Glu148

SCI_norm, the min-max normalised epiSCI score. SCI_norm is an exactly linear transform of MUT_SCI, so the two give identical rankings. Structure distance and the region/flag columns are external annotations and do NOT enter the ranking.

MUT_SCI -0.54272 to 0.25144. The range is set by this run's own extremes, so SCI_norm values are NOT comparable with another run's. The paper's 0.86 threshold does not transfer: here the top 5% boundary is 0.7235 (48 pairs).
P38567 = full-length precursor. mature / rHuPH20 = precursor position - 35, the numbering used in the rHuPH20 patent literature.
Top100 and Top50 are the head of the ranking. All holds the complete 978-pair shortlist.
Co-evolving residue pair, P38567 numbering
Same pair in mature-protein numbering (= pos - 35)
Wild-type residue and the substitution epiSCANEER recommends
Frequency of the wild-type residue pair across the 501-sequence alignment
Raw epiSCI score of the substitution pair
MUT_SCI min-max normalised over all scored substitutions (0-1)
Minimum heavy-atom distance from the residue to catalytic Glu148, in angstrom, measured on PDB 9JUB. Blank when the residue is outside the modelled 37-442 range.

Y when either residue lies within 10 A of Glu148. Those rows are shaded. NOTE: proximity is not evidence of higher activity - the paper's own successful variants sat outside the second shell around the active site.

epiSCI ranks epistatic co-evolutionary support, NOT measured activity. All entries are DOUBLE mutants; the method does not score single mutations. In the paper, success was defined as a 1.03-fold or greater titer increase, and no correlation between SCI and measured activity is reported.

In the top 100 pairs the five biggest hub residues take 68 of the 200 position slots: L165 (39 pairs), A267 (19), N2 (4), F380 (3), E156 (3). Candidate selection should spread across positions rather than take the ranking head as-is.

This run reproduced its inputs and outputs byte for byte from an independent PSI-BLAST submission: the UniRef90 release had not changed, and both PSI-BLAST and epiSCANEER are deterministic. A repeat run on the same database release therefore adds no new evidence; changing the database release or the homolog selection is what changes the result.
2026-10-12. PSI-BLAST submitted 06:47 UTC, finished 06:55; MUSCLE 1.8 min; epiSCANEER 5 min.
